text:
Maria S: Heads up — legal just asked us to preserve a small set of security events for 7y. Proposal: keep SIEM hot index at 90d, route full raw events to cold archive (S3 Glacier/Deep) with CMK-wrapped objects and JIT unwrap for access. Thoughts? :eyes:

Ajay K: Which event categories are in scope for the 7y hold? auth failures, admin key ops, DPI?

Maria S: Legal sent a list: auth failures, privilege escalation alerts, incident evidence artefacts, and sign-ins with elevated roles. I'll drop the doc: https://company.docs/secure/7y-retention (internal)

Leila R: For the cold archive we must gate KMS unwrap with strict RBAC. Suggestion: only Security Leads + Legal retain unwrap permission; oncall can get 1hr access via 2-approver workflow (sec lead + legal).

Sam O: Operationally doable. Implementation sketch: envelope encrypt with arch-CMK, store ciphertext in bucket archive-sec. Provide an unwrap proxy service that: validates ticket -> assumes short role -> calls KMS Decrypt -> streams plaintext to requester. Example CLI (pseudo):
```
# request unwrap (service does checks)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://obj.cipher --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/arch-CMK --grant-tokens "unwrap-ticket-<id>"
```
We can require MFA and log grant token usage.

Ajay K: Can we ensure every unwrap event emits an immutable audit record to the SIEM and triggers an alert if non-standard patterns (e.g., >1 unwrap in 24h for same principal)? Also require MFA as Sam said.

Maria S: Yes — immutable audit trail is must-have. Also we should apply PII redaction at ingest where possible; retain raw only when legal/forensic justification exists.

audit-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/security-config/pull/789 — implements archive routing + sample unwrap-proxy skeleton. Reviewers requested: @Leila R @Sam O

Leila R: One more operational note: change SIEM ingest rules so default index TTL=90d. Events tagged "retain-long" should be routed to archive-bucket with metadata (event_type, reason, retention_policy). Sample ingest rule (pseudo):
```
if event.tags contains "retain-long":
  write to s3://archive-sec/<year>/<id>.cipher
  add metadata: {retain:"7y", reason:"legal"}
else:
  write to siem-hot-index
```

Maria S: Who can pick up the implementation tasks? Need: (1) modify ingest pipeline, (2) PR review + merge, (3) unwrap-proxy prototype + e2e test. Priority: unblock legal.

Sam O: I can own (1)+(3). ETA: config by EOD Friday, basic unwrap-proxy POC + tests next week.

Ajay K: I'll help with the SIEM alert rules and create a detection for anomalous unwrap activity.

Maria S: Great — thanks. I'll coordinate with Legal for the final event list and retention justification. Filing follow-ups in the ticket tracker. :thumbsup:
